ModMetaData.name: [OA]Ratkin Faction: Oberonia aurea
ModMetaData.author: M.Y.G
ModMetaData.description:
“我曾经做过一个梦。” “在那场梦里，我去了一个盛开着金色的鸢尾兰的地方。那里的人们温柔而友善，社区的氛围和谐而繁荣。没有战乱，没有纷争。我不知道那个地方叫什么名字，也许，它叫乌托邦。” "I once had a dream. In that dream, I went to a place where golden irises bloomed. The people there were gentle and kind, the atmosphere of the community was harmonious and prosperous. There were no wars, no strife. I do not know the name of that place, perhaps, it is called Utopia." ~~~~~~~~~~ 本模组在鼠族本体的基础上，新增了一个来自银河系外的星际鼠族帝国：金鸢尾兰帝国。该帝国推崇和谐，氛围友善，若玩家有意与他们交善，那么他们也会尽力帮助玩家，反之也不会畏惧玩家的威胁。 本模组内容： 1个新的鼠族派系，并且拥有特殊的袭击方式与声望系统。 2种新的作物，25种新的枪械，9把新的近战武器，29件配件与头饰，34件服装与外套，23作用各不相同的建筑，27项鼠族科技。 2个新的文化模因与相关戒律，3个新的基因。 230个金鸢尾兰专属背景故事以及2位金鸢尾兰故事叙述者。 本模组为鼠族本体的扩展，需要鼠族本体作为前置，同时必须拥有皇权。兼容文化，生物科技与CE（不完全）。 本模组英文翻译为机翻（因为制作人不懂英语），因此英语质量不会太高，希望有人能够制作翻译补丁。 This module builds upon the Ratkin base mod, introducing an interstellar Ratkin empire from outside the Milky Way: the Oberonia Aurea Empire. This empire values harmony and has a friendly atmosphere. If players wish to establish good relations with them, the empire will make an effort to assist the players. Conversely, they will not shy away from a player's threats.
Contents of this module include: - 1 new Ratkin faction with unique raid tactics and a reputation system. - 2 new crops, 25 new firearms, 9 new melee weapons, 29 accessories and headgear, 34 pieces of apparel and coats, and 23 buildings each with distinct functions. - 27 Ratkin technologies. - 2 new cultural memes and associated doctrines, and 3 new gene. - 230 Oberonia Aurea-specific background stories and 2 Oberonia Aurea story narrators.
This module is an expansion of the Ratkin base and requires the Ratkin base mod as a prerequisite, as well as the Royalty expansion. It is compatible with Cultures, Biotech, and Combat Extended (CE)(incomplete).
The English translation of this mod is machine-translated (as the creator does not speak English), so the quality of the English may not be high. Hopefully, someone can create a translation patch to improve it. ~~~~~~~~~~ 金鸢尾兰帝国发源自寒冷的金鸢尾兰母星，最初以氏族议会的形式在风雪中挣扎求生，直到后续研发出了一系列温控科技后才逐渐改善了生活环境，并在氏族议会的基础上建立起了帝制政体。 如今的金鸢尾兰帝国已经拥有了广袤的疆域，并于近期通过空间异常点成功抵达了银河系边缘。在第一次与银河系的接触中，由于从未经历过战争以及自身社会环境的和谐与繁荣，因此金鸢尾兰帝国派出的第一批殖民队并未携带武装。随后，在边缘世界降落的无武装殖民队立刻遭到了当地势力的劫掠与屠杀，几乎无人幸免。 而当极少数幸存者将消息回报至金鸢尾兰帝国时，得益于集权化的制度，金鸢尾兰帝国立刻调整了对外姿态，并且在通过一系列对银河系文明的观察与接触后仿照银河系建立起了自己的军工体系，组织了第一支职业化的军事部队。 如今的金鸢尾兰帝国已经与破碎帝国签订了武装殖民协议，他们已经做好了再次出发的准备。不像第一次手无寸铁，这一次，金鸢尾兰的绽放必将伴随硝烟。 The Golden Iris Orchid Empire originated from the cold Golden Iris Orchid home star. At first, it struggled to survive in the snowstorm in the form of clan parliament, until a series of temperature control technologies were developed, the living environment was gradually improved, and an imperial regime was established on the basis of clan parliament. Today's Golden Iris Orchid Empire has a vast territory, and recently successfully reached the edge of the Milky Way through spatial anomalies. In the first contact with the Milky Way, the first colonial teams sent by the Golden Iris Empire were unarmed because they had never experienced war and the harmony and prosperity of their own social environment. Subsequently, the unarmed colonial team that landed in the marginal world was immediately looted and slaughtered by local forces, and almost no one was spared. When a few survivors reported the news to the Golden Iris Empire, thanks to the centralized system, the Golden Iris Empire immediately adjusted its foreign posture, and after a series of observation and contact with the civilization of the Milky Way, it established its own military industry system and organized the first professional military force. Today's Golden Iris Empire has signed an armed colonial agreement with the Broken Empire, and they are ready to start again. Unlike the first unarmed, this time, the blooming of iris aurea will be accompanied by smoke. ~~~~~~~~~~ 金鸢尾兰系列计划： 如今金鸢尾兰扩展系列，按照顺序分别为： [OA]鼠族派系扩展：金鸢尾兰（就是这个）； [OA]鼠族基因扩展; [OA]鼠族剧本扩展：风雪的遗孤； [OA]鼠族扩展：骑士团（锐意制作中）；
金鸢尾兰的本体开发原本预算仅为3500，但最终因为种种原因共计花费10000余元，因此如果您没有生活压力并且愿意支持，那么您的赞助将会是我日后更新的最大动力。（收款码在文件夹内） 此外，彩蛋文件夹内的图片除了商业用途以外可以随意使用，发布到公共平台标明出处即可。
The Oberonia Aurea Series Plan: Nowadays, the Oberonia Aurea Series expands as follows: [OA]Ratkin Faction: Oberonia aurea (which is this one); [OA]Ratkin Gene Expand; [OA]Ratkin Scenario: Snowstorm Orphan; [OA]Ratkin: Knight Order (Underway with great determination).
The initial budget for the development of the Oberonia Aurea core was merely 3,500 CNY. However, due to various reasons, the total cost ended up exceeding 10,000 CNY. Therefore, if you are without financial pressure and are willing to offer support, your sponsorship would be the greatest motivation for future updates. (The payment QR code can be found within the folder)
In addition, images within the easter egg folder can be freely used for non-commercial purposes. Just credit the source when publishing on public platforms.
